verdict.rationale: Cline can run long-running dev servers and react to their output live [cline-docs-14]. It can also use a browser and take browser actions with approval [cline-docs-1, cline-docs-31, cline-docs-22], and fix layout issues from screenshots [cline-docs-18]. Together these support an observe-run-fix loop against a running web app, but the evidence never explicitly describes debugging a live application. missing for 10: explicit live-app debugging workflow (console/network log inspection, breakpoints or debugger attachment), documentation of what browser interaction covers, independent hands-on corroboration of debugging a running web app.
